terms: контрольный полёт (обычный рейс, на котором проводят замеры)

qa.q: Why do you use data from a Geiger counter if it does not measure neutrons?
qa.a: Our measurements only show the problem: at cruising level radiation is much higher. For the law, the dose must be calculated with a special program. This is one of our proposals.

qa.q: So is there no regulation in Russia at all?
qa.a: There is a limit: 5 millisieverts a year. The problem is that the law does not say who calculates the dose and how. So nobody can check the limit for each person.

qa.q: Why do you suggest 1 millisievert as a threshold?
qa.a: The same threshold is used in the European Union and in Germany. Old Russian sanitary rules also used it. Above this level, the dose should be calculated for each person.

qa.q: Will this be expensive for airlines?
qa.a: Not very. A computer program can calculate the dose from flight data that airlines already have. In France, airlines use one common state system for this.

The sanitary rules — the Chief State Sanitary Doctor. Flight time rules — the Ministry of Transport. The check of working conditions — the Ministry of Labour. Most changes do not need new federal laws.
